title: Plex: Find Movies & TV Shows
summary: Watch tons of movies & TV shows at no cost and see what's trending in streaming.
description:
Discover what to watch next with Plex. 

Find any movie or TV show and where it’s streaming, then add it to your watchlist for easy access when you’re ready to press play. Plex is the only entertainment app that gives you every way to discover what you want to watch, easier than ever before. 

When you use Plex as a TV show tracker and movie finder, you can spend less time searching and more time watching. Connect all your streaming services to Plex to see what’s trending across platforms. Then create a universal Watchlist to organize everything you want to watch, no matter where it’s streaming. Share your thoughts with TV and movie reviews, and connect with a community of fellow fans and friends.

Stream 50,000+ free movies and TV on demand, and more than 600 free Live TV channels with no subscription. Enjoy access to popular movie and TV options from A24, Paramount, AMC, Magnolia, Relativity, Lionsgate, and more.

Love Live TV? Watch TV anywhere for free with Plex. Featuring an easy-to-use guide, Live TV on Plex includes over 600 free TV channels with news, kids' shows, live sports, and more, including: The Hallmark Channel, FOX Sports, FIFA, WNBA, NFL Channel, PBS Antiques Roadshow, and more. Start streaming and catch your favorites on Plex like The Walking Dead Universe, Ice Road Truckers, Game Show Central, and NBC News Now.

Rent classic movies and new releases fresh from theaters with Plex Rentals. Simply sign in, browse the Plex rentals library, and rent your favorite movies or TV series. Download the app now to enjoy Plex anywhere.

PLEX FEATURES

DISCOVER MORE WITH PLEX
- Watchlist movies and shows from anywhere
- Browse all your streaming services in one app (when you connect them to Plex)
- See what’s trending and where to watch it
- Find friends and compare watchlists
- Get ratings and movie reviews from friends you trust

WATCH FREE TV ANYWHERE
- Enjoy over 600 Live TV channels at your fingertips, on every device
- From true crime and game shows to Spanish-language channels and live sports, there’s something for everyone
- Stream news and local channels like CBS, Financial Times, Euronews, and more

ALL NEW RENTALS
- Enjoy newly released movies and classic favorites with Plex Rentals
- Stream movies like Sinners, Marty Supreme, Wuthering Heights, Weapons, and more
- Rentals start at just $3.99

PLEX PERSONAL MEDIA SERVER
- Plex scans, organizes, and automatically sorts your personal media
- Easily manage your personal media library in our app
- Store your movies and TV shows, and stream them on any device
- Download your personal media and watch without WiFi using our offline video player

Visit https://www.plex.tv/free for more information.

Note: Streaming personal media requires Plex Media Server version 1.41.2 or higher (available for free at https://plex.tv/downloads) installed and running to stream to other devices. DRM-protected content, ISO disc images, and video_ts folders are not supported. Some features of this app are supported by interest-based advertising. To learn more about this and your choices regarding it visit the Plex Privacy Policy.
